strategy.goal: Generate qualified investor interest in the product and its proposition.
strategy.audience: Crypto-native investors, research teams and ecosystem operators.
strategy.rationale: Combine specialist discovery with long-form explanation; test whether attention translates into qualified product use.
exclusions: Token-price movements are not a success metric.
Deck requests are not onchain revenue or qualified-wallet proof.

allocations.rationale: Test discovery among relevant investor networks.
Explain the proposition and product evidence in depth.
Provide a considered follow-up for specialist readers.

assumptions: Audience descriptions require source-backed creator review.
Investor interest and wallet activity are different signals; neither proves investor identity.

measurement.qualifyingAction: Select the project's instrumented Solana product action.

missingEvidence: Current creator availability, quotes and audience evidence need review.
No comparative campaign outcomes validate these starting allocations.
Project conversion instrumentation and retention coverage need confirmation.
rebalanceQuestions: Which creators generated qualified actions after attention?
Does the evidence justify renewing long-form distribution?
